pr.body: ## Summary - Fixes #6193: multiline descriptions in the API documentation editor lost visible line breaks after blur/re-edit (especially on macOS desktop). - Overrides the global `textarea { truncate }` styles (`white-space: nowrap`) in `MarkdownEditor.vue` with `whitespace-pre-wrap overflow-auto`, matching the pattern already used in `Assistant.vue`. ## Test plan - [ ] Open request documentation, enter a multiline description, blur to save - [ ] Click the description again to re-enter edit mode — line breaks should remain visible - [ ] Confirm markdown preview still renders soft breaks correctly - [ ] Smoke-test on macOS desktop (WKWebView) if available --- ## Summary by cubic Fixes multiline descriptions in the API documentation editor losing visible line breaks after blur/re-edit on macOS desktop. The `textarea` class now uses `whitespace-pre-wrap overflow-auto` instead of `text-wrap`, overriding the global truncate styles that forced `white-space: nowrap` on the element. Written for commit 1ebdecefbf0a9900c36cdd131f7025b317a4cf48. Summary will update on new commits.
pr.title: fix(common): preserve line breaks in documentation description editor
